required_conventions_before_unified_acco: Choose base currency and dated USD/CNY conversion marks at every cash movement, fill and NAV mark; no FX series is present in the frozen L1 input frames.
Order A-share and US trading events on actual Asia/Shanghai instants, retaining separate exchange calendars and US daylight-saving changes.
Define each sleeve's capital allocation and capital-transfer policy after returns drift; record cash, borrowing, short-sale proceeds, collateral and margin separately.

Define whether overlapping US ETF positions across B7.8, B7.9 and C remain separate broker subaccounts or net into one account; if netted, recalculate quantity, spread, fees and financing on the net executed orders.
Resolve A and ADK strict quantity/cash/short self-financing gaps and C continuous scaled-lot gap before reporting a physical unified NAV.
Mark US 2026-09-25 without treating the last China close from 2026-09-24 as a contemporaneous China trading event.
minimum_independent_checks: Per event, independently sum post-fill security values plus currency cash and collateral minus debt and short liabilities to equity.
For each market session, carry previous quantities to the next eligible execution time and reprice with that market's validated adjusted/raw price convention; no fills on closed-market dates.
Reconcile costs to positive executed turnover, loan charges to actual outstanding debt and borrow/margin limits to aggregate rather than sleeve-local capital.
Bridge every sleeve's final account return to portfolio equity changes after FX, transfers, costs and overlapping-order netting; a weighted average of sleeve net returns is insufficient.
performance_windows: N/A for physical unified account until FX, collateral, shared borrowing and C/A/ADK continuous ledgers are defined and recomputed
